reviews.text: All the staff are friendly and very understanding. You really get the sense that they care for your fur babies and want the best for them, not just the money. When my cat was unwell, I was so scared I was willing to have all the tests done, and the vet said we could have those done, but they weren't necessary and would be very expensive. We went ahead with treatment which was cheaper and he's now perfectly healthy. I would always recommend McDonalds Vets and won't go anywhere else. Thank you all ❤️

I'm so glad I registered my pets with this vets. My 11yr old cat had a health check as I was concerned about her and the vet examined her thoroughly,  advised for bloods to be done which I was happy to agree to.

I'm very happy with the service at McDonald's Vets. I'm always greeted with a warm welcome and so is my dog, Coco.

I'm very happy with the care and advice given for my pet and the way staff will look for the best options for medication and prices.

I've been taken before my appointment time a few times when I've arrived early and I've never waited more than a few minutes past my appointment time.

I'm very happy with the care that's provided to myself and Coco.

Had a great first time experience with my new puppy at McDonald's vets in scotstoun. We received excellent care & procedures with great & informative advice going forward for growth to a healthy, happy dog.
The vets are very friendly and have been a God send to me helping me get to my boys underlying health issues, lifted a weight off my shoulders.highly recommend.
